_note: 學習路徑內容第22批 #2／6：不定詞當形容詞／副詞（eng.t_mid.nonfinite.infinitive-adj-adv，會考級／中階）。不定詞（to + 原形）可當形容詞放名詞後修飾（something to eat / work to do）、可當副詞表目的（to buy milk）、也接在 too／enough 後（too hot to drink / old enough to drive）；此類不定詞都保留 to（非原形不定詞）。誘答鎖『省略 to／用動名詞取代／用 for + 原形／too↔enough 語意顛倒』等唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix iaa_）。

units.can_do: 我能用不定詞（to + 原形）當形容詞修飾名詞（something to eat）、當副詞表目的（to buy milk），並用在 too／enough 之後（too hot to drink、old enough to drive）。
units.situation_group: 非限定動詞：不定詞的形容詞／副詞用法
units.subject: eng

claims.text: An infinitive can act like an adjective, following a noun to describe it: 'I need a pen to write with.' / 'She has a lot of work to do.'
claims.verification_ref: 不定詞可當形容詞放名詞後修飾（a pen to write with / work to do）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: An infinitive can act like an adverb of purpose, telling why someone does something (= in order to): 'He stood up to greet her.'
claims.verification_ref: 不定詞可當副詞表目的（= in order to）：He stood up to greet her；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Infinitives also follow 'too' and 'enough' as adverbials: 'too tired to walk', 'strong enough to lift it.' 'enough' follows the adjective (tall enough), 'too' goes before it (too tall).
claims.verification_ref: too/enough 後接不定詞（too tired to walk、strong enough to lift it）；enough 放形容詞後、too 放前；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: This infinitive always keeps 'to'; it is not a bare infinitive: say 'a plan to help', not 'a plan help'.
claims.verification_ref: 此類不定詞保留 to、非原形不定詞（a plan to help, not a plan help）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: An infinitive (to + verb) can work like an ADJECTIVE: it comes after a noun and tells us more about it. I have some letters to write.
teach.zh_hint: 不定詞（to + 動詞）可以當形容詞用，放在名詞後面，進一步說明這個名詞：I have some letters to write.（我有一些信要寫。）

teach.body: I have some letters to write.
teach.zh_hint: 我有一些信要寫。to write 修飾 letters，當形容詞。

teach.body: An infinitive can also work like an ADVERB OF PURPOSE: it tells WHY someone does something (= in order to). She called to say thank you.
teach.zh_hint: 不定詞也可以當表目的的副詞，說明某人『為什麼』做某事（等於 in order to）：She called to say thank you.（她打電話來道謝。）

teach.body: She called to say thank you.
teach.zh_hint: 她打電話來道謝。to say thank you 說明打電話的目的。

teach.body: Infinitives also follow 'too' and 'enough', and this infinitive always keeps 'to'. Note the position: 'too' goes BEFORE the adjective (too young to drive), but 'enough' goes AFTER it (old enough to drive).
teach.zh_hint: 不定詞也會接在 too 和 enough 後面，而且這種不定詞一定保留 to。注意位置：too 放在形容詞前面（too young to drive），enough 放在形容詞後面（old enough to drive）。

teach.body: He is too young to drive.
teach.zh_hint: 他太小還不能開車。too 放在形容詞 young 前面。

teach.body: She is old enough to drive.
teach.zh_hint: 她年紀夠大可以開車了。enough 放在形容詞 old 後面。

practice.stem: 選正確：I'm thirsty. I need something ____.（我渴了，需要喝的東西）

distractor_rationales.drink: something 後要用不定詞 to drink 當形容詞修飾，不是單獨原形 drink。
distractor_rationales.drinking: 這裡用不定詞 to drink 修飾 something，不用動名詞 drinking。
distractor_rationales.drank: 要用不定詞 to drink，不是過去式 drank。

practice.feedback: something to drink：不定詞當形容詞修飾 something。

practice.stem: 選正確：She went to the library ____ a book.（她去圖書館借書）

distractor_rationales.borrow: 表目的用不定詞 to borrow（為了借書），不是單獨原形 borrow。
distractor_rationales.for borrow: 表目的用 to + 原形（to borrow），不用 for + 原形。
distractor_rationales.borrowing: 表目的用不定詞 to borrow，不用動名詞 borrowing。

practice.feedback: …to borrow a book：不定詞當副詞表目的（為了借書）。

practice.stem: 選正確：This box is too heavy ____.（這個箱子太重，提不動）

distractor_rationales.carrying: too 後面接不定詞 to carry，不用動名詞 carrying。
distractor_rationales.carry: too heavy 後要用不定詞 to carry，不是單獨原形 carry。
distractor_rationales.for carry: 用 to + 原形（to carry），不用 for + 原形。

practice.feedback: too heavy to carry：不定詞接在 too 後面表『太…以致不能』。

practice.stem: 選正確：She is tall ____ to reach the shelf.（她夠高，搆得到架子）

distractor_rationales.too: too tall to reach 表『太高以致搆不到』，與『夠高搆得到』語意相反。
distractor_rationales.very: very 不接不定詞表『足以』；表『足夠…可以』要用 enough to。
distractor_rationales.so: so 要用 so…that 接子句；表『足夠…可以』要用 enough to。

practice.feedback: tall enough to reach：enough 放形容詞後，接不定詞表『足以』。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（我有很多功課要做）
practice.answer: I have a lot of homework to do.
options: I have a lot of homework to do.
I have a lot of homework do.
I have a lot of homework for do.
I have a lot of homework doing.

homework 後要用不定詞 to do 當形容詞修飾，不能只用原形 do。
用不定詞 to do，不用 for + 原形。
這裡用不定詞 to do 修飾 homework，不用動名詞 doing。

practice.feedback: homework to do：不定詞保留 to、當形容詞修飾 homework。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: She came early to help us set up.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：came early、目的不定詞 to help、us set up、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。不定詞連讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: I have a few things to buy at the store.
lines.intonation: things to buy 連讀、store 句尾下收

lines.text: He turned on the light to see better.
lines.intonation: to see better 表目的、better 句尾下收
